LPG Mobilift uses the ENDERMOLIFT technique which provides fast, visible results: radiance and anti-fatigue effect.

The results amplify with each session, effectively eliminating wrinkles, firming contours, refining and reshaping your face, balancing out your complexion, and by and far improving your skin quality.
Firms the skin, reducing sagging skin around eyes (droopy eyelids), nasolabial folds (laugh lines) and jowls
Brightens dull complexion by increasing lymphatic microcirculation which detoxifies the effects of stress, pollution, lack of sleep

Research conducted by Prof. Philippe Humbert from the University Hospital of Besancon (France), proved that mechanical stimulation from LPG Mobilift treatment is able to reveal a firmer, younger looking skin by:

  • Boosting the skin’s ability to produce hyaluronic acid to restore the skin’s volume and hydration
  • Promoting collagen production to prevent aging and fine lines and
  • Encouraging natural synthesis of elastic fibers to improve skin’s suppleness

The patented LPG handpiece gives a real ‘skin workout’ with the motorized flaps. This moving action sends signals to skin cells and awakens the natural production of fibroblasts (rejuvenating cells) which boosts their production of collagen (firmness), elastin (suppleness), and hyaluronic acid (volume and hydration), naturally present in our skin.
